description: One call before you buy a Robinhood Chain token: avoid, caution or ok, with every reason. Combines the rug check (who holds the Uniswap v4 liquidity, or the Pons bonding-curve fill), liquidity pulls after buyer bursts, the pre-call flags if the token was called (ran >= 3x before the post, same-block wallet cluster, < 30 min old), the token's age, and our desk's own last trade and shadow outcome on it. The rules are listed in every response. Untracked tokens answer 404 and are not charged. Rug check and pool data rewritten every 20 s, pre-call and desk data every 30 s; stale inputs are refused (503, not charged). Research data from our own paper-trading desk, not trading advice. Costs $0.03 USDC per call (x402).
